solution: Early blight in tomato can be controlled by removing infected leaves, improving air circulation, avoiding water on leaves, and applying recommended fungicides like Mancozeb.
Rice blast can be managed by using resistant varieties, balanced nitrogen fertilizer, proper irrigation, and suitable fungicide application.
Wheat rust management includes resistant varieties, field monitoring, and applying fungicides when infection appears.
For tomato crops, balanced NPK fertilizer improves plant growth. Apply fertilizer according to soil condition and crop stage.
